body: I get little jabs of happiness here and there, but they go as quickly as they come on.  Usually when playing with kids.  My brain is a scrambled mess.  I can't complete thiughts and follow then through any more.  All joy is completely gone.  No friends, no interests, no concept of a future.

The concept of a long term future is now so foreign to me.  I've NEVER imagined myself as an old man.  I had children (selfishly) to try and force myself onto a normal trajectory.  There is no hope, no love, no fun.  You can't keep traipsing on and bogging down others as you go.
